index_line: - [[focal-dome-flax]] — 8 Ω (3.3 Ω min), tiny sealed satellite, LW ±3.2 dB, f3 126 Hz, pref 1.8 (ASR)
brand_notes: Dôme Flax is Focal's home-theater/lifestyle satellite (4" flax woofer, sealed, 171 mm), sold singly (~$689 each, MSRP $799) and in 5.1 packs; ASR recommended against it (asr-focal-dome-flax). Form factor is borderline for bookshelf scope; kept in scope as passive 8 Ω shelf-capable monitor.
takeaways: ASR Klippel: LW ±3.2 dB, f3 126 Hz, sens 83.0 dB computed vs 88 dB claimed.
Heavy distortion; ASR limited tests to 90 dB.
Wide, smooth directivity (143/119 deg) but ER dip 3.7 dB.
Pref score 1.8 (5.5 with sub); ASR does not recommend.
Scope is a judgement call (satellite form factor); price per pair derived from per-each snippet.
conflicts: claimed 80 Hz FR vs f3 126 Hz
log_bullets: Conflict: sensitivity 83.0 vs 88 claimed; scope borderline (satellite)
